ITEM.PTXT: At vehicle shipment, 10000 or more songs of music data of various genres are encrypted and preinstalled in the HDD navigation system. By selecting the desired songs or course and purchasing online from the G-BOOK center a license key that removes the encryption, music can be easily enjoyed in the vehicle.

With the adoption of a hard disk for the navigation system, a digital rights management system (G-DRM: Digital Rights Management) that stores and manages encrypted music data on the hard disk has been incorporated, ensuring thorough copyright management and protection.
G-SOUND and AUTOLIVE have been adopted as amusement that can be enjoyed in the vehicle.
The amusement menu screen is displayed by pressing the "Information/G" panel switch and touching "Amusement" on the displayed information mode screen.
A wide range of music, from J-POP and enka to jazz and classical, can be purchased. In addition, music data can be added and updated using a maintenance CD (G-Library disc).
A CD-ROM containing encrypted music data of approximately 100 songs each, selected by genre and theme, including the latest J-POP, kayokyoku, Jazz/Classic, Pops/Rock, etc.
Karaoke and BGM can be used with unlimited singing and listening for a fixed monthly payment. There is also a download course in which songs or channels are purchased individually using tickets.
For the download course, tickets must be purchased first.
